constant.name: Fixed
constant.description: {virtualUserCount} virtual {virtualUserCount, plural, =1{user} other{users}} run for {totalDurationMins, plural, =1 {# minute} other{# minutes}}, each executing all requests sequentially.

ramp.name: Ramp up
ramp.description: {initialDurationMs, plural, =0 {Steadily} other {{initialLoad, plural, =1 {# virtual user} other {# virtual users}} run for {humanizedInitialDuration},}} ramp up to {maxLoad} for {humanizedRampDuration}, then maintain {maxLoad} for {humanizedMaxLoadDuration}, each executing all requests sequentially.

load.name: Initial load
load.description: A number of VUs to simulate before starting to ramp up to the maximum number of VUs.

time.name: Ramp up timestamp
time.description: The time over which load is linearly increased from initial to maximum load.

peak.name: Peak
peak.description: {initialDurationMs, plural, =0 {Steadily} other {{initialLoad, plural, =1 {# virtual user} other {# virtual users}} run for {humanizedInitialDuration},}} ramp up to {maxLoad} over {humanizedRampUpDuration}, maintains {maxLoad} for {humanizedPlateauDuration}, decrease to {initialLoad} over {humanizedRampDownDuration}, maintains {initialLoad} for {humanizedTrailingLoadDuration}, each executing all requests sequentially.

load.name: Base load
load.description: The number of VUs to maintain before beginning the ramp to the maximum VU count, and after scaling back down.

time.name: Ramp up timestamp
time.description: The time over which load is linearly increased from base to maximum load.

time.name: Ramp End timestamp
time.description: The time over which maximum load is maintained.

time.name: Ramp down timestamp
time.description: The time over which load is linearly decreased from maximum to base load.

spike.name: Spike
spike.description: {initialDurationMs, plural, =0 {Spike} other {{baseLoad, plural, =1 {# virtual user} other {# virtual users}} run for {humanizedInitialDuration}, spikes}} to {maxLoad} over {humanizedSpikeUpDuration}, drops to {baseLoad} over {humanizedSpikeDownDuration}, maintains {baseLoad} for {humanizedFinalDuration}, each executing all requests sequentially.

load.name: Base load
load.description: The number of VUs to maintain before beginning the ramp to the maximum VU count, and after scaling back down.

time.name: Spike peak timestamp
time.description: The time at which the spike has peaked at the maximum load.

humanize_duration.expanded: {minutes, plural, =0 {} =1 {# minute } other{# minutes }}{seconds, plural, =0 {} =1 {# second} other{# seconds}}
